title: Greek-Style Chicken Skewers
blurb: Tender chicken and summer squash threaded onto skewers, seasoned with oregano and grilled until lightly charred.
steps: Cut the chicken cutlets into 2 cm chunks and place in a bowl with the oregano, black pepper, half the olive oil and half the salt, then toss to coat.
Cut the pattypan squash into quarters and toss with the remaining olive oil and salt.
Thread the chicken and squash pieces alternately onto metal or soaked wooden skewers.
Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high heat and cook the skewers for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and both chicken and squash have char marks.
Squeeze the lemon over the skewers and serve immediately.
